summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K solely to furnish Q1-2026 financial statements of Penney Intermediate Holdings LLC and related store performance disclosures, along with a press release. No transaction, offer, or special situation event is described. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure under Regulation FD and Item 8.01, with no bearing on any acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or corporate action.
